note: Wall time in milliseconds of one full 7-question check of a story plan, warm (GPU already awake, 2 warm-up checks discarded), measured once for each system on the same 20 story-plan states, one after another. Tuned Glimmer: 7 parallel answer-token requests. Muse Spark and Base Glimmer: one request for all questions. Hybrid: the tuned model's 5 requests plus one Muse Spark Open request for the two fact checks, in parallel. The headline speed is the median of the 20. Per-row timings were not recorded, so this file is the only timing data. GPU wake-up and the idle tail are not included.
